topic_components.criterion: The joint visible projection reads as a camera above the subject looking down, rather than eye-level with a high background.
topic_components.evidence_expected: Crown and shoulder tops seen from above alongside a broad tabletop and floor.

topic_components.criterion: Crown or hair top, shoulders, tabletop and surrounding floor expose upper surfaces together.
topic_components.evidence_expected: Independent top surfaces reinforce one downward projection.

topic_components.criterion: Upper body is visually nearer/larger, with knees and feet receding toward the ground.
topic_components.evidence_expected: Qualitative relative scale and foreshortening; actual camera height is not measurable from the generated image.

topic_components.criterion: Some face and the table front edge remain visible while the camera looks down.
topic_components.evidence_expected: A sloped oblique view rather than a flat plan view.

topic_components.criterion: A stable vertical reference and downward projection distinguish high angle from merely tilting the frame.
topic_components.evidence_expected: Window frame approximately upright and depth projection still downward.

confusion_boundaries: eye-level viewpoint with subject lowering her head
pure vertical overhead or flat plan view
wide lens making head larger without multiple downward-looking planes
a label or prompt mention without visible perspective

full_scene_components.criterion: Visible face and dark bob with fine bangs provide qualitative appearance-reference correspondence; no identity claim.
Paper worktable, drying boards and window sill form the studio setting.
Right hand grips brush contacting paper, left palm steadies far corner, broad bristle patch and flattening edge are legible.
Hips sit on square wooden stool, both feet visibly contact floor, connected torso/arms plausibly reach sheet.
Separate metal ruler and shallow pigment dish are visible; soft window light reveals paper/linen texture.
Hands, brush contact, paper, stool and feet are visible together.

runtime_measurement_limit: A generated perspective can support an elevated-view interpretation, not a measured real camera height or focal length.
